hardware.approve_input: GPIO14 long press from final Decision page
hardware.reject_input: GPIO0 long press from any active review page

procedure: Built the T-Display S3 firmware with ESP-IDF v5.5.4 from /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh.
Sent a valid serial sign_event request so the display entered a live trusted-review session.
Navigated to the final Decision page and long-pressed KEY/GPIO14.
Sent a fresh valid serial sign_event request after reset.
Long-pressed BOOT/GPIO0 from the active review flow.
Committed the matching ESP32 source revision, rebuilt from a clean tree, reflashed, and reran USB serial protocol smoke.
expected_result: Long KEY/GPIO14 closes the active review with Review OK / Closed / Not signed / Signing disabled / Send new request, long BOOT/GPIO0 closes it with Rejected / Closed / Not signed / Signing disabled / Send new request, and the protocol still returns signing_disabled.
observed_result: Manual physical confirmation showed the approve path rendering Review OK / Closed / Not signed / Signing disabled / Send new request and the reject path rendering Rejected / Closed / Not signed / Signing disabled / Send new request. The clean dc26555 firmware build was reflashed afterward and passed 33 USB serial smoke exchanges with sign_event remaining signing_disabled.
limitations: This is terminal review-screen validation only; it is not production signing acceptance.
Approve/reject closes the RAM-only review session but does not authorize or execute signing.
The protocol response for sign_event remains signing_disabled.
No persistent key custody, secure boot, flash encryption, debug-lock, enclosure, or production approval policy was validated.
